mapper.select: SELECT message.* FROM afv_agent_message message LEFT JOIN afv_agent_run run ON run.run_id = message.run_id WHERE message.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND message.deleted = 0 AND message.parent_tool_call_id IS NULL AND run.parent_run_id IS NULL ORDER BY message.message_order
SELECT MIN(message_order) FROM afv_agent_message WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM afv_agent_message FORCE INDEX (uk_agent_message_projection_key) WHERE projection_key = #{projectionKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_agent_message call_message LEFT JOIN afv_agent_message result_message ON result_message.run_id = call_message.run_id AND result_message.tool_call_id = call_message.tool_call_id AND result_message.role = 'tool' AND result_message.tool_status IN ('success', 'error', 'cancelled') AND result_message.deleted = 0 SET call_message.tool_status = 'cancelled', call_message.update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE call_message.run_id = #{runId} AND call_message.role = 'tool' AND call_message.tool_status = 'running' AND call_message.deleted = 0 AND result_message.id IS NULL
